verdicts.reason: A is a clean left-to-right banner: brand, one-line headline and subcopy sit in one aligned block, the badges are stacked as a group, and the CTA is clearly prominent on the right. Its flaws are a tiny phone graphic with a crowded circle and a slightly loose gap between the badges and the CTA. B has several problems. The SOLSTICE wordmark floats to the left of the headline instead of above it. The two-line headline is jammed against the top edge, and the subcopy is tiny. The CTA is shrunk to badge size and stacked under BACK BY DEMAND, so it reads as another badge. SUMMER ONLY is stranded on its own, and there is dead space between the phone and the text.
